```{r}

cost_df <- bind_rows(costs_list, .id = 'run')

cost_df$Dollars <- round(cost_df$Dollars)



cost_df <- arrange(cost_df, run, Dollars)

cost_df$run <- as.numeric(cost_df$run)

cost_df

#Removes rows the Total Cost Rows
cost_dfm <- cost_df[!(cost_df$Cost_Type == 'Total Cost'),]

cost_dfm <- arrange(cost_dfm, run, Dollars)

cost_dfm <- ddply(cost_dfm, 'run', transform, label_ypos=cumsum(Dollars)-0.5*Dollars)

cost_dfm

#Axis labels and Boundaries


#Scatter plot of run vs. dollars with the different costs colored
ggplot(cost_df, aes(x = run, y = Dollars)) + geom_point(aes(col = Cost_Type)) + theme_minimal() + 
 labs(title='Plot of Costs vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,2500)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))

ggplot(cost_df, aes(x = run, y = Dollars)) + geom_point(aes(col = Cost_Type)) + geom_smooth(aes(color=Cost_Type),method=lm) + theme_minimal() +
labs(title='Plot of Costs vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,2500)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))
#Box, violin, and Dot Charts

ggplot(cost_df, aes(x = Cost_Type , y = Dollars)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cost_Type)) + theme_minimal()+
labs(title='Plot of Various Costs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,2500)) 
ggplot(cost_df, aes(x = Cost_Type , y = Dollars)) + geom_violin(aes(color = Cost_Type)) + theme_minimal()+
labs(title='Plot of Various Costs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,2500)) 
ggplot(cost_df, aes(x = Cost_Type , y = Dollars)) + geom_dotplot(aes(color = Cost_Type, fill = Cost_Type), binaxis = 'y', stackdir = 'center') + theme_minimal()+
labs(title='Plot of Various Costs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,2500)) 




#Stacked bar chart with 
ggplot(cost_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Dollars, fill = Cost_Type, label = Dollars)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + theme_minimal()+
labs(title='Plot of Costs vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,2500)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))
ggplot(cost_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Dollars, fill = Cost_Type, label = Dollars)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + coord_flip() + theme_minimal()+
labs(title='Plot of Costs vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,2500)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))
ggplot(cost_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Dollars, fill = Cost_Type, label = Dollars)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + coord_flip() + geom_text(aes(y = label_ypos, label=Dollars)) + theme_minimal()+
labs(title='Plot of Costs vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,3500)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))
ggplot(cost_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Dollars, fill = Cost_Type, label = Dollars)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +  geom_text(aes(y = label_ypos, label=Dollars)) + theme_minimal() +
labs(title='Plot of Costs vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Dollars')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,3500)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))
```

```{r}
i_tech_df <- bind_rows(i_tech_list, .id = 'run')
#i_tech_df$colour <- rep(c('b','b','b','b','b','r','r','r','r','r','r','b','b','b','b','b','b',),10)
#i_tech_df$Dollars <- round(i_tech_df$Dollars)



i_tech_df <- arrange(i_tech_df, run, Capacity)

i_tech_df$run <- as.numeric(i_tech_df$run)

i_tech_df

#Removes rows the Total Cost Rows
i_tech_dfm <- i_tech_df

i_tech_dfm <- arrange(i_tech_dfm, run, Capacity)

i_tech_dfm <- ddply(i_tech_dfm, 'run', transform, label_ypos=cumsum(Capacity)-0.5*Capacity)

i_tech_dfm

#Scatter plot of run vs. dollars with the different costs colored
ggplot(i_tech_df, aes(x = run, y = Capacity)) + geom_point() + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='Tech Capacity vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Capacity (kWh or Gal')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,15)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25))

ggplot(i_tech_df, aes(x = Technology , y = Capacity)) + geom_violin(aes(color = Technology)) + theme_minimal()+

ggplot(i_tech_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Capacity, fill = Technology, label = Capacity)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + theme_minimal()+

ggplot(i_tech_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Capacity, fill = Technology, label = Capacity)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity')  + geom_text(aes(y = label_ypos, label=Capacity)) + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title='Tech Capacity vs. Runs', x='Runs', y ='Capacity')+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,150),ylim=c(0,15)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,150,25)) + coord_flip()

ggplot(i_tech_dfm, aes(x = run, y=Capacity, fill = Technology, label = Capacity)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +  geom_text(aes(y = label_ypos, label=Capacity)) + theme_minimal() +
```

```{r}
ww_water_prod_df <- bind_rows(ww_water_prod_list, .id = 'run')
#ww_water_prod_df$colour <- rep(c('b','b','b','b','b','r','r','r','r','r','r','b','b','b','b','b','b',),10)
#ww_water_prod_df$Dollars <- round(ww_water_prod_df$Dollars)




ww_water_prod_df <- melt(ww_water_prod_df, id = c('run', 'month'))

ww_water_prod_df$variable <- as.character(ww_water_prod_df$variable)

ww_water_prod_df$value <- as.numeric(ww_water_prod_df$value)

ww_water_prod_df_hrw <- as.data.frame(ww_water_prod_df[(ww_water_prod_df$variable == 'H_RW'),])


ww_water_prod_df




#Removes rows the Total Cost Rows
ww_water_prod_dfm <- as.data.frame(ww_water_prod_df)



ww_water_prod_dfm <- as.data.frame(ww_water_prod_dfm[,-1])

ww_water_prod_dfm

ww_water_prod_dfm <- aggregate(ww_water_prod_dfm$value, by = list(ww_water_prod_dfm$month, ww_water_prod_dfm$variable), FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE, na.action = NULL)


ww_water_prod_dfm$value <- ww_water_prod_dfm$x

ww_water_prod_dfm$month <- ww_water_prod_dfm$Group.1

ww_water_prod_dfm$variable <- ww_water_prod_dfm$Group.2





ww_water_prod_dfm

#Scatter plot of run vs. dollars with the different costs colored
ggplot(ww_water_prod_df, aes(x = month , y = value)) + geom_point(aes(col = variable)) + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='White Water Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,6000)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))

ggplot(ww_water_prod_df, aes(x = month, y = value)) + geom_point(aes(col = variable)) + geom_smooth(aes(col=variable),method=lm) + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='White Water Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons') + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))


ggplot(ww_water_prod_df_hrw, aes(x = month, y = value)) + geom_point(aes(col = run)) + geom_smooth(aes(col=run),method=lm) + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='H_RW Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons') + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))+theme(legend.position = "none")

#Stacked Area
ggplot(ww_water_prod_dfm, aes(x = month, y = value, group = variable)) + geom_area(aes(y=value, fill = variable ))+theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='White Water Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,450000)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))
ggplot(ww_water_prod_df_hrw, aes(x = month, y = value, group = run)) + geom_area(aes(y=value, fill = run ))+theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='H_RW Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons') + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))

#Line Graph
ggplot(ww_water_prod_dfm, aes(x = month, y = value, group = variable)) + geom_line(aes(linetype=variable, color = variable))+theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='White Water Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1000)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))
ggplot(ww_water_prod_df_hrw, aes(x = month, y = value, group = run)) + geom_line(aes(linetype=run, color = run))+theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='H_RW Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons') + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))+theme(legend.position = "none")


#Stacked bar chart with 
ggplot(ww_water_prod_dfm, aes(x = month, y=value, fill = variable, label = value)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='White Water Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,450000)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))

ggplot(ww_water_prod_dfm, aes(x = month, y=value, fill = variable, label = value)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + coord_flip() + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='White Water Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,450000)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))

ggplot(ww_water_prod_df_hrw, aes(x = month, y=value, fill = run, label = value)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity')  + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='H_RW Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons') + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))
ggplot(ww_water_prod_df_hrw, aes(x = month, y=value, fill = run, label = value)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity')  + coord_flip() + theme_minimal()+
  labs(title='H_RW Production by Month', x='Month', y ='Gallons') + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,12,1))
```

```{r}
org <- ww_water_prod



ww_water_prod$Hour <- as.factor(ww_water_prod$Hour)
ww_water_prod$Hour <- as.numeric(ww_water_prod$Hour)
ww_water_prod <- ww_water_prod[complete.cases(ww_water_prod[,2]),]
ww_water_prod <- melt(ww_water_prod, id = c("Technology", "Hour"))

ww_water_prod

i <- 1
while(i <= nrow(ww_water_prod)){
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 2){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 3){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*2
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 4){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*3
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 5){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*4
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 6){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*5
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 7){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*6
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 8){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*7
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 9){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*8
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 10){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*9
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 11){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*10
  }
  if(ww_water_prod$variable[i] == 12){
    ww_water_prod$Hour[i] <- ww_water_prod$Hour[i] + 705*11
  }
  i <- i + 1
  
}













```
